changes: Fixes #1158: holding FUNC while turning D off (writing the rhythm to the track) no longer makes a short click on the audio outputs.
The click came from the conversion briefly holding up the audio engine. The audio now keeps running while the rhythm is written.
Nothing else changes: plain D off, the converted trigs and saved settings work as before.
Fixes #662: with Euclidean open, TRIG, SRC, FLTR, AMP and LFO now go to that page, as from any parameter page. Before, only NO closed it.
FUNC + TRIG, FLTR, AMP or LFO now opens Quantize, Delay, Reverb or Compressor from Euclidean. Before, some of these changed only the header.
FUNC + SRC has no stock action and keeps Euclidean open.
First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, on Core 2.1. Generate rhythms from two pulse generators on each audio or MIDI track.
Rotate either generator, rotate the whole result and combine them with OR, XOR, AND or SUB.
